		prerequisite = { focus = WAG_bng_governorate focus = WAG_bng_self_sufficient focus = WAG_bng_private_army focus = WAG_bng_train_burkina focus = WAG_bng_train_mali }
		# completes itself when the First European War begins (on_weekly_WAG)
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = WAG_bng_storm_avail_tt
				has_global_flag = SOV_nato_war_begins_global
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { factor = 1 }
		completion_reward = {
			set_country_flag = WAG_storm_in_europe
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = WAG_car_transport_troops } set_country_flag = WAG_done_WAG_car_transport_troops }
			load_focus_tree = {
				tree = WAG_europe_focus_tree
				keep_completed = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
